row.title: Reopen a closed deal
row.note: reopened and flagged the stale close date

final_reply:
I reopened **Northwind - POS Upgrade** (Northwind Traders). It had been marked Closed Lost and is now at **Proposal/Price Quote**. The probability went up to 75% on its own. The amount ($17,000) and sales rep (Luis) are unchanged.

**The close date is still 2026-04-24, which is six months ago.** An open deal with a past close date will look overdue and can throw off forecast reports. What should the new close date be? I can update it once you tell me.
